title: Fiscal Calendars and Metric Definitions
brief: In pairs, build a 10-term glossary for the Meridian wealth domain. Start with AUM,
Every term needs a named OWNER and an IMPLEMENTATION ROUTE — where the definition will
actually live: a metric view, a UC function, a curated view, or an instruction.
Disagreements are the point of this exercise, not a problem with it. If you and your
partner agree on all ten immediately, you have probably chosen easy terms.
review: All ten terms have a named owner, not a team.
Each has an implementation route, and 'an instruction' is used sparingly.
At least one disagreement is recorded rather than resolved by whoever spoke louder.
'Client' is recognised as harder than it looks — household, relationship or account.

inputs.title: Glossary template, and the five terms to start with
rows: Term | What it means | Owner (a person) | Implementation route | Disagreement recorded
Implementation route is one of: metric view · UC function · curated view · instruction.
Reach for 'instruction' last — it is the weakest place to settle a definition.
Start with these five, then add five of your own:
AUM          three defensible readings live in this data
return       four columns could answer it, across six period types
net flows    depends on whether exchanges count
quarter-end  fiscal or calendar, last business day or last calendar day
client       household, relationship, or account — the data has only one of these
If you and your partner agree on all ten immediately, you picked easy terms.
